Name: Alternative Rasmodia
Author: TheGaurdian2142
Description:
[b][size=3]Alternative Rasmodia[/size][/b]

Update Rasmodia, the female witch, with a new look and a variety of new outfits that you can set Season by Season. 

[b][size=3]Outfits:[/size][/b]
[i][b]Witchy[/b][/i]
- Inspired by the Original Rasmodia Style
[i]
[b]Classic, Floral, Color[/b][/i]
- New modern style that can also come with a seasonal floral touch or seasonal color change. 
[i]
[b]Corset[/b][/i]
- New style to give a cottage cozy vibe. 

[i][b]Bust[/b][/i]
Give Witchy and Classic an update for a little more mature style.

[i][b]Relaxed Mode[/b][/i]
When you arrive in the Valley, Rasmodia is alone and withdrawn. As your relationship with her blooms, see a more relaxed and comfortable style for Rasmodia. This feature can be turned off and set Season by Season

[b][size=3]Install Instructions:[/size][/b]
Download Mod File
Unzip File into your Stardew Valley Mod Folder
Run Stardew Valley to create Config Options
Access the Config File or Mod Settings in game to update Outfits
